Each equilateral triangle has perimeter 21 inches, so each of its sides is 21 ÷ 3 = 7 inches.

The six triangles meet at the hexagon's center. Each triangle's outer side is one side of the hexagon. So every side of the hexagon is 7 inches.

The hexagon's perimeter is 6 × 7 = 42 inches.

ANSWER: 42
